description: Agent Migration: submit the field and concept mapping between the source and the target of one move: each source field or concept with the target field it lands in, its disposition (mapped, merged into one target field with others, dropped, or with no counterpart on the target), whether the plan names the drop, the unit, currency or time zone on each side with the conversion between them, the status or category values each side uses with the value map between them, and the data type on each side; and optionally every field the source schema holds. The signed report lists every mapping as carried, changing meaning, dropped or unstated, every drop with whether the plan names it, and every meaning change with its unit, stranded values and type, and names a mapping that corrupts data without failing: fields dropped silently or never mentioned, fields with no counterpart on the target the plan does not name, fields that keep their name while their unit or currency changes with no conversion, and status values with nowhere to land; then several source fields poured into one target field and data type changes with no conversion, with the fix for each. Whether an asset class can be carried to another service in principle is wever_identity-portability-check or wever_reputation-portability-check. Verdict mapping_corrupts, mapping_gaps, mapping_unverified or mapping_faithful. POST /api/migration-mapping-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

mappings.description: Each field or concept on the source with where it lands on the target.

conversion.description: How values are converted between the two units, such as divide by 100.

disposition.description: Mapped, merged into a target field with others, dropped, or with no counterpart on the target.

named_in_plan.description: The plan names the drop or the missing counterpart.

source.description: The source field or concept, such as order_status or amount.

source_type.description: The source data type, such as datetime or string.

source_unit.description: The unit, currency or time zone on the source, such as cents or USD.

source_values.description: The status or category values the source uses.

target.description: The target field it lands in; left out when it has none.

target_unit.description: The unit, currency or time zone on the target.

target_values.description: The status or category values the target uses.

value_map.description: How each source value maps to a target value.

source_fields.description: Every field the source schema holds, to read for fields the mapping never mentions.

name: wever_migration-mapping-check
title: Migration mapping check
